1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000020_SOLUTIONRESIDENT73
1.description: S-Stay back! Stay away from me!

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000060_SOLUTIONRESIDENT73
5.description: A sentry walked into my apartment...even though I'd locked the door and everything!

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000070_SOLUTIONRESIDENT73
6.description: I managed to run, but the man who tried to save me...

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000080_KRILE
7.description: No weapons. Which is to be expected, considering all the sentries were meant to be disarmed.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000090_KRILE
8.description: Yet it was ordered to attack all the same...even if that meant using its bare hands...

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000100_GEODE
9.description: I'll leave matters here to you. I'm going to do a sweep of the surrounding area.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000110_ORIGINALSPHENE
10.description: Do you know anyone else in this sector who no longer wears a regulator?

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000120_SOLUTIONRESIDENT73
11.description: Uh... Oh, I don't think I've seen Isadora and her boy with theirs recently...

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000150_WAYAKKWE
14.description: I'll be fine. But Isadora's in bad shape...

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000180_ORIGINALSPHENE
17.description: Thank goodness, she wasn't struck anywhere vital...

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000190_WAYAKKWE
18.description: I'm sorry... If only I'd gotten here sooner...

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000200_ORIGINALSPHENE
19.description: Everything will be all right. I promise to make your mother better.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000220_MILOS
21.description: Will she sleep like that forever...?

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000230_ORIGINALSPHENE
22.description: No, not forever. She'll wake soon, I'm sure of it.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000260_GEODE
25.description: This is the only place left. Let them be safe...

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000270_WAYAKKWE
26.description: Geode, are you there? Answer me, please!

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000280_GEODE
27.description: I'm here. Sorry for the long silence─I've been busy.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000310_GEODE
30.description: The radius next door. The lobby is secure.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000320_GEODE
31.description: I'll scout the second floor, then I'll join...

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000340_WAYAKKWE
33.description: “Dust”? What are you talking about? What's happening?

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000350_GEODE
34.description: They're not just collecting souls. They're draining the bodies of corporeal aether.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000360_GEODE
35.description: The “dust” that we saw was all that was left of the victims. They must have modified the soul cells...

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000400_GEODE
39.description: You can't be here! You need to run─now!

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000440_GEODE
43.description: Take care of the others, eh?

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000450_ORIGINALSPHENE
44.description: No sign of him so far. This way, maybe...?

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000480_CALYX
47.description: (-???-)A shame. I had hoped to leave here with at least one more cell's worth of aether.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000490_CALYX
48.description: (-???-)But seeing how eager you are to interfere, I shall cut this foray short.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000510_ORIGINALSPHENE
50.description: What could you possibly stand to gain from these...these atrocities!?

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000520_CALYX
51.description: (-Calyx-)Aether sufficient to generate five thousand Endless. How would you acquire it?

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000540_CALYX
53.description: (-Calyx-)Until I have the key, the reflections are closed to me. Thus do I make do with the sources at hand.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000550_CALYX
54.description: (-Calyx-)Seven percent of Alexandria's current population will yield the energy to convert five thousand into Endless. With eleven percent, operations could continue unabated for eight hundred years.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000560_CALYX
55.description: (-Calyx-)Our bodies are fated to decay, sooner or later. These ones refused the gift of eternal life, so what difference does it make if I return them to aether now?

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000570_CALYX
56.description: (-Calyx-)I will not waste time and resources on meaningless conflict. This unit cannot offer you worthwhile resistance.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000580_CALYX
57.description: (-Calyx-)Instead, I pose a question: would you hand over the key if I promised to halt my harvest?

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
59.description: You would only seek other victims.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
60.description: I will halt your harvest by defeating you.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000600_CALYX
62.description: (-Calyx-)It was foolish of me to even ask.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000610_CALYX
63.description: (-Calyx-)I return to my work, then. There is much to do if I must take the key by force.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000630_GULOOLJA
65.description: The soldiers... If only I'd been able to control them...

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000640_NOSTALGIA
66.description: This isn't your fault, Gulool Ja. The blame lies with Calyx, and with him alone!

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000660_NOSTALGIA
68.description: Why force his plans upon us when we're already happy, living our lives? What does he even think life is!?

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000670_NOSTALGIA
69.description: I'll never forgive Calyx for doing this...

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000680_NOSTALGIA
70.description: Or myself for being powerless to stop him!

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000700_NOSTALGIA
72.description: To clear my head. Don't worry, I won't do anything stupid.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000710_KRILE
73.description: Stay here and get some rest. I'll make sure Nostalgia stays out of trouble.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000730_SHALE
75.description: Things would've been far worse if you and Geode hadn't rushed in there. Many people are still alive because of you.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000740_SHALE
76.description: And after adding what you discovered to the leads we've dug up, I'm hopeful we can determine where Calyx is hiding.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000760_SHALE
78.description: We need time before we can move on. Just a little time...

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000780_SHALE
80.description: Whenever we lost a comrade, the three of us would come back here to reminisce. Me, Geode, and Cahciua...

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000810_NOSTALGIA
86.description: What are the two of you doing here?

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000820_SHALE
87.description: I had a feeling you'd show up. Would you like to join us?

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000840_NOSTALGIA
89.description: I suppose I could spare a moment.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000850_NOSTALGIA
90.description: They tell us Oblivion's founders disappeared some decades ago under <hex:021A020203>mysterious circumstances<hex:021A020103>, and it was Cahciua who revived our organization.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000860_NOSTALGIA
91.description: You and Geode helped her with that, didn't you? Tell us more about it.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000870_NOSTALGIA
92.description: You're keen to know too, right? What they were like back then, the mad things they got up to... That sort of thing!

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000880_SHALE
93.description: Ah, those were the days. It was actually right before the reformation that I met Geode.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000890_SHALE
94.description: I still wore a regulator then, and had recently lost someone close to me.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000900_SHALE
95.description: I'd also just quit a long stint as an adapter to work at a bar, of all places. They paid me to sit with patrons and “keep them company.”

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000910_SHALE
96.description: So Geode came in one night, and it wasn't long before we got into an argument. First-time customer, but tempers flared. And then one of us threw a punch...

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000920_NOSTALGIA
97.description: You got into a fistfight!? What were you even arguing about...?

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000930_SHALE
98.description: Damned if I know. We were deep in our cups. I think we were both just frustrated and angry at...everything.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000940_SHALE
99.description: By the end of it, we were both sprawled out in the street. A pair of drunken fools. Then this odd machine stopped to lecture us, scolding us for obstructing the foot traffic and not taking better care of ourselves...

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000950_KRILE
100.description: I can't imagine you ever being in such a sorry state.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000960_KRILE
101.description: The odd machine... That was Cahciua, I take it?

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000970_SHALE
102.description: That it was. Once she was done upbraiding us for our unseemly behavior, she launched into a recruitment pitch.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000980_SHALE
103.description: Cahciua explained that she wanted to protect the “outside world” from Zoraal Ja's invasion─to keep him from bringing ruin to the place her beloved son lived. And if we were so intent on self-destruction, then perhaps we might consider risking our hides for a just cause.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_000990_SHALE
104.description: It was a lot to take in. I hadn't given much thought to what lay beyond the barrier, and learning that Cahciua herself was already dead was enough to make my head spin.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001000_SHALE
105.description: But Geode and I were intrigued by her ideas, and wanted to see this future of hers come to pass.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001010_NOSTALGIA
106.description: Geode often spoke of it. He told me that meeting Cahciua was what first taught him the value of remembering people.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001020_SHALE
107.description: Like he was sharing a holy revelation.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001030_NOSTALGIA
108.description: Oh, but... Back then, you hadn't yet taken on Oblivion's name, had you?

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001040_KRILE
109.description: Is that so? I'd just assumed...

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001050_SHALE
110.description: It hadn't been Cahciua's intention to carry on Oblivion's legacy, nor adopt the cause your parents championed. Not initially, at least.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001060_SHALE
111.description: She wasn't even aware such an organized resistance existed.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001070_SHALE
112.description: She did, however, suspect the presence of other dissidents─those who objected to resurrecting the memories of the dead in defiance of the natural order.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001080_SHALE
113.description: In the hopes of identifying like-minded comrades, we began searching the core system for traces of unauthorized access...and that's how we found it.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001090_SHALE
114.description: An anomalous sector in the back of the Neon Stein. According to Melancholy, the door to that mystery had remained firmly shut since she took over the business.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001110_SHALE
116.description: The Backroom. We forced our way in, only to discover that the hideout had long been abandoned.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001120_SHALE
117.description: Although the occupants were gone, the equipment they'd left behind contained records of a group calling itself “Oblivion.” After reading through their exploits and their vision for the future, we made the decision to carry on their work.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001130_KRILE
118.description: Thus were my parents' and Cahciua's hopes bound together...

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001140_NOSTALGIA
119.description: And carried onward by Shale and Geode...

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001150_SHALE
120.description: We could never have made it this far on our own, of course. Not without the strength of arms you and your friends provided.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001160_SHALE
121.description: Losing comrades is a hard thing, but being here, thinking back on the moments we shared...

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001170_SHALE
122.description: I can see their smiles, hear their laughter. I feel their presence, and I know. They're still with us.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001180_SHALE
123.description: But these memories of mine are for me alone. Reminders of why I chose to do this...and why I'll stay the course.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001190_SHALE
124.description: Right. Time we got back to work. Thank you, everyone.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001200_NOSTALGIA
125.description: No, no, it's me who should be thanking you. Though the pain is still deep, I don't feel like I'm drowning in it anymore...

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001210_NOSTALGIA
126.description: Let's get out there and put a stop to Calyx─for you, for me, and for everyone who's ever believed in Oblivion!

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001230_ALISAIE
128.description: Sorry to drag you out here, but I thought it best you see for yourself...

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001250_ANNOUNCER
130.description: (-Public Announcement-)Though you toil with diligence, death may come ere your reward is bestowed. Though your grand works be poised for completion, death may come ere you wake the following morn.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001260_ANNOUNCER
131.description: (-Public Announcement-)Though you enjoy a life of peace and good fortune, death needs but one instant to claim you.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001270_ANNOUNCER
132.description: (-Public Announcement-)Your bodies are weak. Your heart, your brain, every fragile organ rolls the dice from moment to moment, sheer chance deciding if they function or fail.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001280_ANNOUNCER
133.description: (-Public Announcement-)Be you stoic or generous or righteous, no virtues tip the scales in that fatal reckoning.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001290_ANNOUNCER
134.description: (-Public Announcement-)The choice is made without reason. The end is cloaked in terror. That is what it means to die.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001300_ALPHINAUD
135.description: The announcement began after we finished our meeting with Gossan. As for its source, well...

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001320_ANNOUNCER
137.description: (-Public Announcement-)There is no shame in being afraid. It is that very fear which will drive you to conquer death.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001330_ANNOUNCER
138.description: (-Public Announcement-)Let us set a new course for mankind. Let us preserve our existence unto perpetuity.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001340_ANNOUNCER
139.description: (-Public Announcement-)Hope for it. Wish for it. Pray for it. We will become Endless.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001350_ANNOUNCER
140.description: (-Public Announcement-)With evolution's brilliance will we banish the ever-present darkness of mortality...

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001360_BLACKREGULATOR73
141.description: Change isn't easy. No one ever wants to take the first step.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001370_BLACKREGULATOR73
142.description: But this...this <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> the right path for us. What other way could there be? I'm gonna do it─I'm going to register!

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001390_IRRITATION05306
144.description: (-Agitated Citizen-)You couldn't have come at a better time. Please, you have to let us move to Tuliyollal!

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001400_BEWILDERMENT05306
145.description: It's too dangerous to stay here. And who knows when the next sentry will turn on us...

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001410_BEWILDERMENT05306
146.description: Even if we wanted to become Endless, there are no more neo regulators to be had... Fleeing is our only option.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001420_BLACKREGULATOR73
147.description: If the solution was as simple as leaving, then we'd all have left already. Did you not hear the announcement? For the living, death is a foregone conclusion.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001430_BLACKREGULATOR73
148.description: No matter where we go, or who we shelter with, we won't get another chance like this to overcome our fate.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001440_IRRITATION05306
149.description: (-Agitated Citizen-)Easy for you to say when you have that regulator!

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001460_WUKLAMAT
151.description: The Landsguard are on their way as we speak, and arrangements have been made to see that you all will be safely evacuated.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001470_WUKLAMAT
152.description: Tuliyollal will aid you in whatever way we can...

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001490_ORIGINALSPHENE
154.description: I want to help Alexandria. I want to save its people...

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001520_ORIGINALSPHENE
157.description: So this is one of Preservation's laboratories...?

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001530_WUKLAMAT
158.description: It's so dark, I can barely see...

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001540_SHALE
159.description: Just a moment. If I can reroute the power to the circuit...

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001560_KRILE
161.description: Smell how stale the air is. This room hasn't been in use for many years.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001570_SHALE
162.description: It was thanks to Krile and Gulool Ja that we managed to locate this place.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001580_KRILE
163.description: You may remember that my earring contained the control code for the gate to the golden city.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001590_KRILE
164.description: As it was Preservation that constructed the portal, we reasoned that the code to operate it might include a signature of some sort unique to their organization.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001600_SHALE
165.description: So I took a closer look, and a line-by-line examination yielded a string of symbols identifying the code's author.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001610_SHALE
166.description: We then began accessing the nodes for every door in Everkeep, seeking out control codes which contained those same symbols...

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001620_SHALE
167.description: After a grueling search, we finally discovered our prize behind door number one-eight-six-zero. The entrance to the facility in which we now stand. I'd probably still be at it if Gulool Ja hadn't been around to assist me.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001630_GULOOLJA
168.description: I took breaks, but Shale never stopped working. Not even once.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
171.description: Sounds like you need one of Genolt's energy tonics!

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001640_SHALE
172.description: I can contribute precious little else, I'm afraid, but...I appreciate your kind words.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001650_SHALE
173.description: Those concoctions would probably do me more harm than good, but...I appreciate the sentiment.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001660_SHALE
174.description: In any case, this next part will require your helping hands.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001670_KRILE
175.description: We need to spread out and search for something that may lead us to Calyx.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001680_ORIGINALSPHENE
176.description: We're more than happy to help, of course, but I wonder... Won't he realize we've found this place?

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001690_SHALE
177.description: It's highly likely. And personally, I hope he does.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001700_PRESERVATIONMAN73
178.description: Are you really planning to leave?

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001710_PRESERVATIONWOMAN73
179.description: Yes. The idea of eternal life, it's begun to frighten me...

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001720_PRESERVATIONWOMAN73
180.description: I struggle to renounce our conventional wisdom. Death is the means by which life prunes its branches, leaving the trunk to grow strong and tall. We die so that our species may flourish.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001730_PRESERVATIONWOMAN73
181.description: What would become of mankind were we to halt that process? If unending stagnation is the fruit of our labor, then perhaps we strive for the wrong thing...

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001740_PRESERVATIONMAN73
182.description: Your argument is a rejection of Master Calyx's vision.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001750_PRESERVATIONWOMAN73
183.description: I suppose it is. Perhaps such dread would not plague me were I capable of sharing his perspective on the subject.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001760_PRESERVATIONWOMAN73
184.description: But I cannot. He and I are too different, in too many ways.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001770_PRESERVATIONWOMAN73
185.description: I lack his extraordinary genius. I had no illness threatening to cut my life short; no singularity of will to cut away all distractions and focus solely upon research...

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001780_PRESERVATIONWOMAN73
186.description: I have nothing but respect for his determination. The way he overcame his prognosis and seized the means to transcend death itself...

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001790_PRESERVATIONWOMAN73
187.description: But I'm not convinced that this obsession with living is the right path. That's why I've decided to leave Preservation, and put all my effort towards building a legacy for the next generation to come.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001810_PRESERVATIONMAN73
189.description: Protocol, you understand. There can be no exceptions.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001820_WUKLAMAT
190.description: This terminal doesn't look special to me, but...this is definitely what we're after?

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001830_SHALE
191.description: It is. But whether or not it will suffice for our purposes is another question...

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001840_KRILE
192.description: The Endless are created using the memories of the deceased. But as memories are, in essence, collections of data, the resultant entities have no physical form.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001850_KRILE
193.description: These “data entities,” as we might call them, have only two methods for interacting with the material world.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001860_KRILE
194.description: One of these we saw in Living Memory, where the Endless are granted temporary bodies through the use of corporeal aether. They become much like solid ghosts that one can see and touch.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001870_KRILE
195.description: The other method, which Cahciua employed, is the remote operation of a machine. But where do you suppose the Endless are to be found when not inhabiting a physical body?

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001880_ORIGINALSPHENE
196.description: Hmmm... The Endless are memories, and if memories are data, then...

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
199.description: In a world formed of data?

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001890_KRILE
200.description: Yes, we suspect they reside in a virtual domain, one contained entirely within an electrope-based machine. We've seen such a realm before, after all.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001900_WUKLAMAT
201.description: Oh, you mean like the Alexandria made from the Endless Sphene's memories... It all seemed so real!

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001910_ORIGINALSPHENE
202.description: So this virtual domain... It would also be housed within the Meso Terminal?

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001920_WUKLAMAT
203.description: But...how? I thought we shut down all the terminals in Living Memory.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001930_SHALE
204.description: You did, and Cahciua's program performed just as she intended.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001940_SHALE
205.description: The Meso Terminal itself was deactivated, as evidenced by the failure of the device which was keeping Sphene's body in stasis.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001950_SHALE
206.description: Be that as it may, we face a master of electrope engineering. That he managed to partition and protect the sector harboring his own memories is well within the bounds of possibility.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001960_KRILE
207.description: Let us say that the Meso Terminal does indeed contain a second domain, and that Calyx himself resides there. This city, on the other hand, exists here in the Source.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001970_KRILE
208.description: That being the case, I thought perhaps we could prevent his remote interference by closing the gate to the golden city and thus severing the connection between worlds...

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001980_SHALE
209.description: Except I tried to close it once already when I visited Living Memory. The process required administrative authorization─a restriction I assumed at the time had been imposed by the queen.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_001990_WUKLAMAT
210.description: But now you think Calyx might be responsible.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002000_SHALE
211.description: Just as I suspected. Even now, security transmissions from throughout the keep are being tapped by the core system and routed elsewhere.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002010_SHALE
212.description: Almost every single one has you as its focus. He's keeping track of the key holder's movements...

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002020_CALYX
213.description: (-???-)Time's up. And what a waste of time it's been.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002030_CALYX
214.description: Hoping to find me by tracing the security data? That will not be necessary.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002040_CALYX
215.description: Through a not inconsiderable effort, I've taken your measure and prepared a force sufficient to subdue you.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002050_CALYX
216.description: Come. I invite you to the upper reaches of the Meso Terminal. The storage device which holds my memories is there.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002060_CALYX
217.description: Break the memory bank and victory is yours. I in turn will seek to wrest the key from you with any and every means at my disposal.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002070_ORIGINALSPHENE
218.description: And if we refuse this invitation?

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002080_CALYX
219.description: I will wait. And continue to convert Alexandrians into Endless.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002090_CALYX
220.description: Consider the urgency of the situation and make the wiser choice.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002110_WUKLAMAT
222.description: The Endless Sphene... When she was queen, you had her face an impossible task, then manipulated her into using the key when she was at her most desperate.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002120_WUKLAMAT
223.description: If you can do all that, then why not whisk it away when her plans went to ruin? Why let it fall into our hands?

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002140_CALYX
225.description: You pour salt in the wound... That disaster was a miscalculation on my part.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002150_CALYX
226.description: As her end drew near, Sphene and her restructured memories had become one with the terminal's control systems. In that singular place, in that singular moment, she wielded an authority greater than mine.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002160_CALYX
227.description: Thus she was able to shield you─the neighboring sovereign to whom she entrusted her nation's future, and the hero to whom she entrusted that priceless key.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002170_CALYX
228.description: I am unsure to what degree she perceived my presence, but she knew that <hex:021A020203>someone<hex:021A020103> was watching.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002190_WUKLAMAT
230.description: It does. And I'm satisfied that you will take nothing more from this nation.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002200_WUKLAMAT
231.description: Not one more life, not one more future, not one single smile from another child's face! You hear me!?

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002210_WUKLAMAT
232.description: Sorry for losing my temper, but there's only one way we can deal with people like Calyx.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002220_WUKLAMAT
233.description: Whatever “grand” future he envisions, someone will be made to pay the price.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002230_WUKLAMAT
234.description: And I won't let that happen.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_A5_000_003_NONE_VOICE
238.description: He's wrong if he thinks he's taken our measure.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002240_ORIGINALSPHENE
239.description: If I may... I realize it is not my place to say this...

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002250_ORIGINALSPHENE
240.description: Even so, I must thank you both.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002260_ORIGINALSPHENE
241.description: On behalf of my other self, allow me to say how grateful I am to have you as our champions.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002280_GOSSAN
243.description: In the absence of an official sovereign, I agree that it is not Preservation's place to dictate the future of our nation.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002290_GOSSAN
244.description: However, I also cannot simply take a side and declare my support for your efforts to defeat Calyx.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002300_KRILE
245.description: Is that because of the new regulator you wear...?

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002310_GOSSAN
246.description: I've yet to register it. I find myself caught between the fear of dying and the desire to carry out the duties of governance.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002320_GOSSAN
247.description: My greatest concern is how we shall stem this ever-increasing terror of mortality when becoming Endless is no longer an option.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002330_GOSSAN
248.description: And that's to say nothing of the recent slaughter committed by our own soldiers. The fact that such violence was perpetrated for the very purpose of creating Endless will, paradoxically, make it more difficult to endorse your chosen course.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002340_GOSSAN
249.description: It may not seem logical, but for those who lost friends and family in the attacks, halting the creation process altogether would render the deaths of their loved ones utterly meaningless.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002350_GOSSAN
250.description: Is it not cruel to rob them of what little solace they could claim when we have only just learned what it is to mourn?

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002360_GOSSAN
251.description: Tell me... How are we meant to overcome such tragedies!?

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002370_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
252.description: (-???-)We stop begging others to teach us, for a start.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002380_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
253.description: For the longest time, we've been protected by Queen Sphene and the systems put in place by our forebears.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002390_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
254.description: The hardships and responsibilities of life were distant things, and we felt entitled to our comforts...even as we barely noticed those who risked everything to keep us sheltered.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002400_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
255.description: ...But no more. From now on, we need to learn on our own.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002410_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
256.description: How to live with the promise of death. How to endure the pain of loss.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002420_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
257.description: We may never learn to love such things, but we may learn to survive them.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002430_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
258.description: The people beyond the barrier, even the Alexandrians of old, they've all had to live with these fears. There's no reason we can't do it too!

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002440_WUKLAMAT
259.description: What are you all doing here...?

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002450_MAHUWSA
260.description: Malachite called us in, and the Oblivion members briefed us on the current crisis.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002460_MAHUWSA
261.description: You don't stand idly by while your house burns down.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002465_MAHUWSA
262.description: We came together and thought about how we could help.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002470_TAAPU
263.description: Long story short, we've decided to join the fight alongside Oblivion.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002480_TAAPU
264.description: I say “fight,” but we're well aware of how little use we'd be in actual combat.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002490_MALACHITE
265.description: A battle of <hex:021A020203>ideas<hex:021A020103>, on the other hand─now that we might be qualified to do something about.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002500_MALACHITE
266.description: We'll talk to our neighbors, and do our best to quell their fears. Convince them to make the most of <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103> life and enjoy all it has to offer...

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002510_MALACHITE
267.description: Perhaps that will help to ease your burden?

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002520_KRILE
268.description: It certainly will. Even if a few are assuaged by your words, it will make things easier!

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002530_MALACHITE
269.description: Those who have already registered will be difficult to sway...but there are still many who waver.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002540_MALACHITE
270.description: Those are the ones we'll concentrate on.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002550_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
271.description: Gossan. If you truly care for the people of Alexandria, then now's the time to start thinking of ways to prevent more deaths.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002560_GOSSAN
272.description: Were I to become Endless at the expense of my countrymen's lives, I would regret it for the rest of my existence.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002570_GOSSAN
273.description: Forgive my weakness. When the people have lost their way, it falls to the government to support and guide them.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002580_GOSSAN
274.description: Alexandria can rise above this sorrow, and find its way forward once more.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002620_ORIGINALSPHENE
278.description: No, that wasn't─ What I meant to say was─

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002660_MAHUWSA
282.description: The perfect resemblance to our beloved Queen Sphene has not escaped our notice. Yet we also understand that you are not her.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002670_MAHUWSA
283.description: Having to live in secret, unable to share who you really are... That must have been hard on you.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002680_MAHUWSA
284.description: When you come back, please tell us all about yourself. I imagine yours is a rather outlandish story, but we're eager to hear it all the same.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002690_MAHUWSA
285.description: You're one of us─an Alexandrian─and we don't abandon our own.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002715_ORIGINALSPHENE
288.description: And when I do, I look forward to speaking with you all.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002730_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
290.description: So, listen, you have nothing more to fear than any other normal day. Deep breaths! We'll get through this!

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002750_ERENVILLE
292.description: You'd be telling them much the same if you were here. I suppose it falls to me now...

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002760_CALYX
293.description: Very well... If one by one they fall, I'll send them all as one.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002770_CALYX
294.description: Recall the anguish you felt when you faced death, and rise. Rise to defend your nation, your people, and your loved ones.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002780_CALYX
295.description: Rise, and meet the foe before you.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002800_ORIGINALSPHENE
297.description: The Endless he sent against us... They were from the time of the Storm Surge, before I was placed into stasis.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002810_YSHTOLA
298.description: As far as we know, the only sector to escape the shutdown was the one containing Calyx's memories.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002820_YSHTOLA
299.description: Assuming a chronological system, every other memory stored in that sector would belong to people who lived around the same period in history as he did.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002830_ORIGINALSPHENE
300.description: Calyx... How long have you pursued this madness...?

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002840_ALPHINAUD
301.description: We seem to have exhausted his defenses for the moment. I say we take advantage of this lull to press on.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002860_CALYX
303.description: Well done. I commend your perseverance.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002870_CALYX
304.description: The entirety of my memories are stored within this device.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002880_CALYX
305.description: In the early stages of Endless creation, we established several core tenets. One is a prohibition on memory duplication.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002890_CALYX
306.description: Despite the inherent risks, I agree and abide by this. Memories are the essence of the self, and should not be diluted.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002900_CALYX
307.description: We each have our goals. You seek to destroy your target. I seek to reclaim the key.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002910_CALYX
308.description: Shall we forgo the posturing and begin?

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002920_ORIGINALSPHENE
309.description: Do not doubt that we are here to fight, and I do not mean to lose.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002930_ORIGINALSPHENE
310.description: Yet as one born of the same era, I must ask...

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002940_ORIGINALSPHENE
311.description: Why do you pursue your evolution with such fervor? What do you hope to achieve with this eternal existence?

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002960_CALYX
313.description: I have ascertained a superior path to mankind's preservation. And that which must be done is that which I can do.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002970_CALYX
314.description: What other reason do I require?

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002980_CALYX
315.description: Surely you have seen it. Traditional survival strategies are at odds with an increasingly complex society, leading to a breakdown of order.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_002990_CALYX
316.description: This course promises no liberation from pointless conflicts or inane tragedies. Physical traits do not represent the limit of our potential─why then should we relinquish that potential when our hearts cease to beat?

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003000_CALYX
317.description: I realized it was past time that we corrected our heading. Nothing more.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003010_ORIGINALSPHENE
318.description: Even then, you were always so single-minded.

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003020_ORIGINALSPHENE
319.description: I, too, have a vision for the future, and your plan is not a part of it.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003030_ORIGINALSPHENE
320.description: I won't let you harm another Alexandrian!

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003040_CALYX
321.description: Then fight we must. Thankfully, the entity I now summon will make short work of you and your comrades.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003090_WUKLAMAT
326.description: A chill...? No, something else... I feel so cold...so weak...

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003100_CALYX
327.description: Across Alexandria, a certain emotion is taking hold.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003110_CALYX
328.description: The fear of death. Terror for the eternal darkness that will, without fail, engulf the lives of every living thing.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003120_CALYX
329.description: Allow me to introduce it to you.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003130_IRRITATION05306
330.description: (-Manic Citizen-)I got it... I got one!

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003140_IRRITATION05306
331.description: (-Manic Citizen-)Four thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine. That's how many people he said they were up to!

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003150_IRRITATION05306
332.description: (-Manic Citizen-)I made it just in time. Now to register...

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003170_IRRITATION05306
334.description: (-Manic Citizen-)Death can't touch me now. I'm free of all that crushing fear forever...

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003180_ANNOUNCER
335.description: (-Public Announcement-)Congratulations to all who have acquired a neo regulator.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003190_ANNOUNCER
336.description: (-Public Announcement-)We have reached our total of five thousand registered users. The day of deliverance you were promised will soon be upon us.

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003210_IRRITATION05306
338.description: (-Manic Citizen-)I don't want to die... I don't want to die...

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003240_ANNOUNCER
341.description: (-Public Announcement-)Remember now. Remember your fear of dying.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003250_ANNOUNCER
342.description: (-Public Announcement-)That terror will carry you across the threshold─make of you an Endless. Your prayers will birth a miracle which commands death itself.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003280_CALYX
345.description: Securing the requisite aether is simple. I need only reroute lightning energy from Living Memory.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003290_CALYX
346.description: Then, I encourage the populace to define its form through hope and thought and prayer.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003300_CALYX
347.description: Such an abstract method, however, is rife with unpredictable elements. What I wanted was an entity that could defeat you with utmost certainty.

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003310_CALYX
348.description: To that end, I set strict parameters for a “concept” of my own design.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003320_CALYX
349.description: It was a laborious task, one that required almost more time than I had. But I managed it in the end.

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003330_CALYX
350.description: And now, everything is in readiness. I bid you, come forth!

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003350_YSHTOLA
352.description: A primal summoning, and one defined by a concept no less... How did he learn such techniques...?

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003370_ALPHINAUD
354.description: That is a false deity, brought into being through the prayers of the desperate and the hopeful. The talismans will protect your minds from being enthralled.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003380_CALYX
355.description: Do you still mean to stand against me?

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
357.description: I mean to win. The key will never be yours!

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_A6_000_002_NONE_VOICE
358.description: You have much to answer for...

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003420_CALYX
362.description: Assuming you win. The defeated ask no questions.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003440_CALYX
364.description: ...Shall suffer the rotting fate of all flesh.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003490_CALYX
369.description: I invited you to destroy it. I did not say I would let you.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003500_CALYX
370.description: It is clear your strength cannot be gauged by ordinary means.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003520_ORIGINALSPHENE
372.description: What did you do to it!?

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003530_CALYX
373.description: The ignorance is almost laughable. You do not understand that you yourselves are to blame.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003540_CALYX
374.description: You brought death to my creation.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003550_CALYX
375.description: What do you suppose happens when a being manifested by the fear of dying experiences that terror firsthand? It grows <hex:021A020203>stronger<hex:021A020103>.

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003560_WUKLAMAT
376.description: I feel it again... That same...weakness...

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003590_CALYX
379.description: It will rise again and again, until the lightning which infuses this entire world has been drained to its last spark. You fight a losing battle.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003610_CALYX
381.description: Harnessed in this manner, does it not demonstrate just how powerful mankind's aversion to death truly is?

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003620_CALYX
382.description: You will not prevail against this foe. I, meanwhile, will continue my crusade against mortality.

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003630_CALYX
383.description: So long as our memories endure, we may live on... That is the promise I offer.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003650_ORIGINALSPHENE
385.description: This is wrong, Calyx. You twist the meaning of those words.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003660_ORIGINALSPHENE
386.description: They are not meant to teach the living that physical death is nothing to fear.

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003670_ORIGINALSPHENE
387.description: They are meant to offer comfort to those we leave behind.

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003680_ORIGINALSPHENE
388.description: I know that litany, all too well! I heard it time and time again over the course of the war...

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003690_ORIGINALSPHENE
389.description: Help me, Shale! I must speak to Alexandria. Make my voice heard!

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003700_ERENVILLE
390.description: Naahe, don't you recognize me!? Naahe!

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003710_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
391.description: What's happening!? What's wrong with them!?

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003760_ORIGINALSPHENE
396.description: (-Sphene-)Death can be frightening and terrible... I understand the desire to forget─to seek eternal life and be freed from fear.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003770_ORIGINALSPHENE
397.description: (-Sphene-)Yet we live in this world in the here and now, the bearers of memories varied and rich.

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003780_ORIGINALSPHENE
398.description: (-Sphene-)Our worries can weigh heavy, and there may be nights when the darkness feels like more than we can bear...

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003790_ORIGINALSPHENE
399.description: (-Sphene-)But if we can endure those dark hours, the world will always brighten come the dawn.

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003800_ORIGINALSPHENE
400.description: (-Sphene-)And in the chill of that new morning will the memories of loved ones be there to warm us and carry us forward.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003810_ORIGINALSPHENE
401.description: (-Sphene-)So do not forget their passing... Let them be our courage. Fear not a life well lived.

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003820_ORIGINALSPHENE
402.description: (-Sphene-)For one day, the memories we leave behind will be the warmth another needs when their morning finds them...

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003840_CALYX
404.description: An irregular factor in the equation.

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003870_CALYX
407.description: Memories cannot be duplicated...but they can be transferred.

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003880_YSHTOLA
408.description: Leave the primal to us! Hurry and take care of that memory bank!

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_003960_WUKLAMAT
416.description: I promised I would protect her people!

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004030_ALPHINAUD
424.description: Careful, you're badly hurt. You'd be lucky if you only broke a bone or two.

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004040_ALPHINAUD
425.description: It won't be long until your fever rises. We need to see you back to Tuliyollal, and into the care of a chirurgeon.

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004080_ERENVILLE
429.description: It's been a trial, hasn't it?

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004090_GULOOLJA
430.description: We heard from Koana. He said that Lamaty'i is in no immediate danger and should make a full recovery...

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004100_ERENVILLE
431.description: Vow of Resolve, indeed... Resolved to be as reckless as ever. She might spare a thought for us helpless spectators from time to time.

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004110_GULOOLJA
432.description: You and Lamaty'i and all the others fought so bravely for Alexandria.

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004130_GULOOLJA
434.description: I was useless! Even with the king's authority!

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004140_GULOOLJA
435.description: If I were strong, more people might still be alive!

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
439.description: Those who know weakness first often become the strongest.

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004160_ERENVILLE
440.description: That's right, and you have your whole life ahead of you. We all start somewhere.

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004170_GULOOLJA
441.description: Actually...there's something I'd like you to see.

442.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004180_GULOOLJA
442.description: My father and Otis's swords. I asked Lamaty'i to bring them here.

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004190_GULOOLJA
443.description: I've decided to train under a Landsguard soldier and become a swordsman.

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004210_GULOOLJA
445.description: I'm still not sure if I want to be the King of Resolve. But I want to be strong enough to protect the people I love.

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004220_GULOOLJA
446.description: So I'll train as hard as I can, and then I'll come back here.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004230_GULOOLJA
447.description: When I'm ready to take up these blades...

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004240_GULOOLJA
448.description: That's the path I've decided on!

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004250_ERENVILLE
449.description: Good for you, Gulool Ja. I look forward to seeing your progress.

450.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004260_GULOOLJA
450.description: When I'm bigger and stronger, you'll spar with me, won't you?

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004280_GRAHATIA
452.description: What an absurdly long report. Even working together, it took us an age to finish...

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004290_KRILE
453.description: Well, to be fair, it was a rather absurd series of events.

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004300_KRILE
454.description: The mystery behind Grandfather's letter took us further than we could have ever imagined...

455.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004310_GRAHATIA
455.description: Truly. It feels like a lifetime ago that it all began.

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004320_KRILE
456.description: Right, then. One last bit of proofreading!

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004340_KRILE
458.description: “The chaos which had gripped the Kingdom of Alexandria was slowly but surely giving way to order once more...”

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004350_KRILE
459.description: The thorough investigation conducted by Oblivion was one of the primary factors contributing to this recovery.

460.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004360_KRILE
460.description: Its members uncovered multiple Preservation research facilities, allowing for a comprehensive study of regulator design and function.

461.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004370_KRILE
461.description: Thus have we come to understand that memories pertaining to the deceased were not erased from the minds of the living, but in truth merely locked away.

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004380_KRILE
462.description: Permanent gaps in one's memory were to be avoided, as inconsistencies would arise during Endless conversion and cause instability.

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004390_KRILE
463.description: When the time came, restoring these buried memories would be a simple matter of transmitting a signal from the Meso Terminal.

464.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004400_KRILE
464.description: Acting on this discovery, the Alexandrian government announced plans for a memory restoration initiative open to willing participants.

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004410_KRILE
465.description: This reignited the discussion surrounding mortality, as people continued to debate how best to face the inevitability of death. No matter the answer at which they arrive, it is certain to herald a major shift in the nation's philosophy.

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004420_KRILE
466.description: ...Yes, that matches my understanding of events. Excellent work, Raha.

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004430_GRAHATIA
467.description: I'm glad it serves. Shall we make our way over, then?

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004440_KRILE
468.description: Ahead of the memory restoration, officials requested the assistance of those familiar with the processes involved.

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004450_KRILE
469.description: So it was that our party and Sphene─who had eagerly volunteered─accepted the task of escorting the city's representative to Living Memory.

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004470_MALACHITE
471.description: We just wanted to say that we haven't made this decision lightly.

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004480_MALACHITE
472.description: No matter how frightening or painful they may be, we need to face our memories. Not only to honor those who're gone, but to make whole those who are still here.

473.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004490_MALACHITE
473.description: So no second thoughts! We'll be waiting!

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004500_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
474.description: If anything tries to harm you, you knock it flat! Come back safely, our Sphene from another time!

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004530_ORIGINALSPHENE
477.description: So sweet of you... But you needn't worry─I'm in very good company!

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004540_ORIGINALSPHENE
478.description: Thank you all for your well-wishes!

479.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004550_KRILE
479.description: Despite the disruption caused by the dome's arrival, the people in the surrounding region have since reclaimed their normal lives.

480.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004560_KRILE
480.description: The Tural which Gulool Ja Ja united is nothing if not resilient.

481.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004570_KRILE
481.description: The winds of change are fickle─a sudden gust often the bearer of challenging trials.

482.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004580_KRILE
482.description: But so too do they spur us onward, keeping our feet ever moving along life's path.

483.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004590_KOANA
483.description: You'll soon be on your way to Yak T'el, then?

484.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004600_ORIGINALSPHENE
484.description: Yes, we've just come from making arrangements with the dirigible master. Preparations for the flight are still underway, so I'm doing a little sightseeing.

485.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004610_ORIGINALSPHENE
485.description: My gratitude to the Landsguard for providing us with the permits we need to visit the Skydeep Cenote.

486.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004620_BAKOOLJAJA
486.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Of course! We'd hardly refuse a direct request from the Vow of Reason!

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004630_BAKOOLJAJA
487.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Our vigilant comrades at the gate will see you safely through.

489.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004650_ORIGINALSPHENE
489.description: She is still convalescing, I take it?

490.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004660_KOANA
490.description: Indeed. She's presently confined to bed and permitted no visitors. Weakened as she is, we cannot be too careful.

491.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004670_KOANA
491.description: I can scarcely sleep at night for the worry...

493.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004690_ORIGINALSPHENE
493.description: I hadn't realized her condition was so serious. I pray she makes a full recovery soon...

494.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004700_MABLU
494.description: Greetings! What a rare pleasure this is!

495.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004710_MABLU
495.description: ...Is something wrong? Your friend looks like she had some bad news.

496.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004720_BAKOOLJAJA
496.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)She wanted to visit the Vow of Resolve.

497.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004730_BAKOOLJAJA
497.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)And there's little reason she couldn't have.

498.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004740_KOANA
498.description: Is there something you wish to say?

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004750_MABLU
499.description: I see, I see! I'm glad there's nothing terrible afoot!

500.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004760_MABLU
500.description: And yet... Where there's a need...

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004770_MABLU
501.description: Sorry, I just remembered a pressing errand! Let's talk again soon!

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004780_KOANA
502.description: The Alexandrians, I understand, have teachings similar to that of the Yok Huy.

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004790_KOANA
503.description: “Our flesh may wither and die. But so long as we are remembered, we are never truly gone”...

504.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004800_KOANA
504.description: My father's last words. I've long considered their meaning.

505.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004810_KOANA
505.description: The living can find strength in the memories of those we've lost. They can help us rise to meet our trials in the present.

506.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004820_KOANA
506.description: That was certainly true of myself.

507.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004830_KOANA
507.description: So I have faith that the people of Alexandria, too, will be stronger for their grief.

508.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004840_BAKOOLJAJA
508.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)It may be as you say. If we did not remember our lost siblings, we would not be where we are now.

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004850_BAKOOLJAJA
509.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Or be who we've become.

510.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004860_BAKOOLJAJA
510.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)We all have memories like that, I bet.

511.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004870_ERENVILLE
511.description: Well, we made it. The journey was so smooth as to be almost disappointing.

512.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004880_KRILE
512.description: I can only agree, especially after our first visit felt so fraught with danger.

513.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004890_GRAHATIA
513.description: It's the curse of experience, my friends. Before we know it, the extraordinary becomes everyday.

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004900_GRAHATIA
514.description: Life is an accumulation of such things, both the happy times and the sad.

515.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004910_KRILE
515.description: Right, let's go over Shale's instructions on performing the memory restoration.

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004920_KRILE
516.description: The first step is to reactivate all the terminals at the same time. This will supply the aether necessary to operate the equipment...without creating any new Endless, of course.

517.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004930_KRILE
517.description: Once things are up and running, we use the Meso Terminal to transmit the signal and unlock the sealed memories.

518.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004940_KRILE
518.description: There are five terminals in total. Might you lend us a hand with one, Sphene?

520.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004960_WUKLAMAT
520.description: Not to butt in, but...would you mind letting me take it?

522.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004980_ERENVILLE
522.description: Should you be up and about?

523.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_004990_WUKLAMAT
523.description: I'm fine. My worrywart of a brother exaggerates.

524.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005000_WUKLAMAT
524.description: Mablu came by to fill me in on your plans. After that, I couldn't stand being cooped up a moment longer, so she helped me sneak out of the palace.

525.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005010_ORIGINALSPHENE
525.description: I'm so glad to see you're well!

526.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005020_WUKLAMAT
526.description: Sorry Koana made you think I was at death's door. I was keeping up with reports, and know what's been happening in Alexandria.

527.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005030_WUKLAMAT
527.description: I made the decision to erase the Endless, and bore witness to their final moments. And though it's only a tiny fragment, their hopes live on in me.

528.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005040_WUKLAMAT
528.description: I feel responsible for making sure that they're remembered. That their legacy is passed on.

529.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005050_WUKLAMAT
529.description: So please, let me help with sending the signal.

530.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005060_GRAHATIA
530.description: You've made a convincing case, but do take it slowly. The way is not without its perils.

532.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005080_GOSSAN
532.description: Very well, then. I leave these tasks in your capable hands.

534.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005100_KRILE
534.description: Was the sight we saw no more than a trick of the light?

535.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005110_KRILE
535.description: Or was it a gift─the terminal's parting miracle?

536.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005120_KRILE
536.description: But those days are gone; we chose to move forward.

537.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005130_KRILE
537.description: We hold fast to our memories, of sorrow and of grief.

538.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005140_KRILE
538.description: That we might live full in the present ere the time of departure comes.

539.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005150_ORIGINALSPHENE
539.description: Let's go home... To our beloved Alexandria.

541.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005170_BEWILDERMENT05306
541.description: (-Weeping Citizen-)Mother, you protected me... I remember now...

542.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005180_KRILE
542.description: In soft golden light, the memories of the lost returned.

543.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005190_KRILE
543.description: There to be clutched tight by loved ones, never again to be surrendered.

544.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005200_GOSSAN
544.description: I am humbled by all you have done in service to our nation. On behalf of its people, I offer our most heartfelt gratitude.

545.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005210_KRILE
545.description: We were only too happy to help. There are still problems left to solve, of course, but you've taken an important step forward.

546.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005220_GOSSAN
546.description: We have. It's as if we were frozen in time, but now the ice has begun to thaw. Alexandria will thrive again, mark my words.

547.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005230_WUKLAMAT
547.description: What will you do now, Sphene?

548.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005240_ORIGINALSPHENE
548.description: Ah, yes, well... That will depend on Gossan.

549.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005250_ORIGINALSPHENE
549.description: With your permission, I wish to continue living in Alexandria.

550.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005260_ORIGINALSPHENE
550.description: Those dear to me laid down their lives for this nation in bygone days, and I've fought alongside new comrades to defend it. I would continue serving it, if you'd let me.

551.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005270_ORIGINALSPHENE
551.description: So please, accept me as one of your citizens!

553.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005290_ORIGINALSPHENE
553.description: I see... I suppose my presence would cause too much confusion...

554.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005300_WUKLAMAT
554.description: Now hold on a moment! You have to reconsider─I'll vouch for her myself!

555.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005310_GOSSAN
555.description: Oh dear, do forgive me... I've caused a misunderstanding.

556.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005320_GOSSAN
556.description: What I meant to say is, it will not do for you to be an ordinary citizen. The people have been most insistent that you take your rightful place as queen.

558.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005340_GOSSAN
558.description: When despair held us in its thrall, it was your voice─your words─which led us to salvation.

559.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005350_GOSSAN
559.description: We would not ask that you perform the same duties as our previous ruler. The structure of both government and nation is to be reexamined and revised such that the burden doesn't fall upon you alone.

560.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005360_GOSSAN
560.description: If that is acceptable, we implore you. Please live among us and lend us your gentle guidance.

561.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005370_GOSSAN
561.description: The Alexandrian monarchs of old cared for us and fought for us. And you stand proud among them.

563.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005390_ORIGINALSPHENE
563.description: Oh! What of Gulool Ja? You have him, don't you?

564.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005400_WUKLAMAT
564.description: Alexandria has two thrones to fill now.

565.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005410_WUKLAMAT
565.description: What one ruler might struggle with, the two of you can accomplish together. Gulool Ja's still young, though, so don't expect too much of him just yet.

567.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_A8_000_001_NONE_VOICE
567.description: You already know what to do.

568.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_A8_000_002_NONE_VOICE
568.description: The voices of the past will be your guide.

570.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005430_ORIGINALSPHENE
570.description: For centuries, my other self bore this tiara─and with it the hopes and dreams of Alexandrians.

571.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005440_ORIGINALSPHENE
571.description: I will not let them go unanswered!

572.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005450_ORIGINALSPHENE
572.description: I will heed the wishes of the people.

573.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005460_ORIGINALSPHENE
573.description: With peace and prosperity for Alexandria as my foremost purpose, I accept the role of Queen of Reason.

574.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005470_WUKLAMAT
574.description: It's not an easy road, but we'll walk it side by side.

575.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005480_WUKLAMAT
575.description: That way, neither of us gets lost.

576.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005490_ORIGINALSPHENE
576.description: Thank you. Thank you all so much...

579.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005520_CALYX
579.description: This is absurd. I have neither heart nor lungs...

580.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005530_CALYX
580.description: I was...overconfident. The prudent course would have been to wait until I had calculated an insurmountable advantage.

581.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005540_CALYX
581.description: A rash decision... One perhaps influenced by the others and their developments.

582.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005550_CALYX
582.description: But no matter. Learn from this setback. And next time...

583.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005560_CALYX
583.description: ...“Next time”? How much time and effort did I pour into this master plan?

584.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005570_CALYX
584.description: I had it. I <hex:021A020203>had<hex:021A020103> it! At long last, I was to open a new path!

585.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005580_CALYX
585.description: Those imbeciles and their damnable heroics!

587.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005600_CALYX
587.description: Detected the stench of failure already, have you? Such a keen sense of smell.

588.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005610_CALYX
588.description: Yes, yes, I will give my report, as is protocol.

589.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07300_005620_CALYX
589.description: Be sure our Winterer peers are apprised of the details...
